player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ti panagpukaw ket masapul nga adda iti porma [macro micro] a dagiti numero 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Dagiti indice ket nasken nga aggiddan iti nagbaetan ti 0 ken 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: The micro_board, row, or col is out of range.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Masapul nga agtokar ti agay-ayam iti sumaruno a micro board.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} dimteng iti micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). Player {opponent_id} ket kinamennen a mangplay iti {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Ti agay-ayam {player_id} ket nangabak iti Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
